response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates strong technical depth with extensive experience in distributed systems, high-throughput architectures, and AI-agent infrastructure. His roles as Staff Software Engineer and Senior Software Developer at multiple companies show progression into seniority and technical leadership. However, his background leans more toward web and mobile development rather than pure distributed systems or AI-native environments, which slightly reduces his fit for this role.
strengths: Deep expertise in distributed systems and high-throughput architectures (e.g., micro-services handling millions of HTTP requests per second at Dunnhumby)
Hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP (Model Context Protocol) code generators at re:cinq
Strong system design and architectural skills, with experience in Kubernetes, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines
concerns: Limited direct experience with LLM/ML products or AI-native engineering environments, which is a nice-to-have for this role
Most recent role (Staff Software Engineer at re:cinq) is very recent (started April 2025), making it hard to assess long-term impact
Less emphasis on Python mastery (only mentioned in resume) compared to TypeScript, which is a must-have skill for this role
